        chosen=sorted(candidates_txt)[0]
    elif candidates_pdf:
        chosen=sorted(candidates_pdf)[0]
    else:
        chosen=None
    months.append((mm,chosen))
chosen_files=[c for mm,c in months if c]

import datetime, re
now=datetime.datetime.now(); year=now.year
pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com',password=pw)['access_token']
listing=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/bills/',recursive=True,entry_type='files',access_token=access_token)
# collect all txt internet bills for this year
internet_txt=[p for p in listing if '/internet/' in p and f'/{year}-' in p and p.lower().endswith('.txt')]
print('internet_txt',sorted(internet_txt))
# parse total amounts
months=[]
for path in sorted(internet_txt):
    res=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=path,access_token=access_token)
    content=res.get('content','')
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)',content)
    amt=float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    months.append((path,amt))
    print('path',path,'amt',amt)
# sum
sum_amt=sum(a for _,a in months if a is not None)
print('sum',sum_amt)
